d: Benjamin Netanyahu is leading Israel's election count, but his right-wing bloc has fallen short of a parliamentary majority. With 53 seats projected in the 120-member Knesset, Netanyahu's alliance is eight seats short of the 61 needed to govern. Meanwhile, Arab parties are projected to win a combined 19 seats, potentially giving them a decisive role in coalition negotiations. Netanyahu's Likud party has accused Arab parties of election fraud, alleging bribery, threats, forgery and double voting. The allegations have not been established.
